Perfect! I've fixed the issue. The problem was that the `IconNode` component was using a hardcoded image path (`"/icons/react.svg"`) instead of using the dynamic `data.img_url` property that's being passed to it.

Now the component will correctly display the images based on the `img_url` property in the data object. Looking at the `Skills.jsx` file, I can see that each icon node is configured with different image URLs in the `data.img_url` property, so now the images should be visible.

The fix changes line 10 from:
```jsx
<img src={"/icons/react.svg"} alt="" className="w-full" />
```

to:
```jsx
<img src={data.img_url} alt="" className="w-full" />
```

This will now properly use the dynamic image source that's passed through the `data` prop to each `IconNode` component.
